subject.title: refactor: remove expired plugin compatibility surfaces

question: Should the July 21 release preserve all compatibility records whose `removeAfter` date is still in the future, including the documented provider credential contract?
rationale: The branch intentionally advances a public SDK and upgrade boundary; maintainers must choose the release policy rather than infer that a July 30 window has already elapsed.

options.title: Honor the recorded removal windows
options.body: Keep all future-dated compatibility records and required provider accessors until their documented dates, then land only the already-expired subset.

options.title: Approve an early breaking release
options.body: Deliberately remove the surfaces before their dates only with explicit release approval, upgrade guidance, and a compatible provider-contract migration.

recommendation.title: Honor the recorded removal windows
recommendation.body: Keep all future-dated compatibility records and required provider accessors until their documented dates, then land only the already-expired subset.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author is the only evidenced contributor coordinating this compatibility-removal sweep; confidence is limited because current-main feature-history inspection was unavailable.
